description:
List the ads of one advertiser (competitor), newest and most relevant first.

        Cost: 1 credit per call, whatever the number of ads returned (an empty result too);
        an error costs 0. The next page is a new call (1 credit).

        Args:
            page_id: Numeric advertiser page ID (use search_pages to find it from a brand name).
            country: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country or 'ALL' (default).
            status: 'active' (default), 'inactive' or 'all'.
            media_type: 'all', 'image', 'video', 'meme' or 'none'.
            platforms: Subset of facebook, instagram, messenger, audience_network, threads.
            languages: ISO-639-1 language codes.
            active_from: YYYY-MM-DD.
            active_to: YYYY-MM-DD.
            sort: 'relevance' (default), 'impressions' (most impressions first) or 'longevity'
                (longest-running first: days_active, applied to the returned page).
            min_days_active: Keep only ads running for at least this many days (applied to the
                returned page, so fewer ads may come back; same cost). Long-running ads are
                the ones that work ("winning ads"): each ad has days_active and a 0-100
                winning_score (longevity, variants, EU reach).
            limit: Ads per page, 1-30 (default 10).
            cursor: next_cursor from a previous call, to get the next page (same filters).
name: get_page_ads
title: List an advertiser's ads
